Content Creator & Digital Marketing Executive Job at Alphacom




        
    

        
        Alphacom is a leading technology retail and distribution company based in Ikeja, Lagos, committed to providing genuine technology products, innovative solutions, and exceptional customer service.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Content Creator & Digital Marketing Executive

Job Location: Computer Village, Ikeja - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: ICT / Technology Retail

Description
     

            
    




	Are you a creative storyteller with a proven ability to turn content into sales? We're looking for a Content Creator & Digital Marketing Executive who can create engaging content, grow our online presence, and drive measurable sales results.


Responsibilities


	Create high-quality photo, video, and graphic content for social media and digital campaigns.
	Plan and execute digital marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, leads, and sales.
	Manage the company's social media platforms and ensure consistent audience engagement.
	Conduct keyword research and optimize content for search visibility.
	Identify and target the right audience for products and campaigns.
	Plan, launch, monitor, and optimize paid social media advertising campaigns.
	Develop content calendars and marketing campaigns aligned with business goals.
	Monitor campaign performance and provide regular reports with actionable insights.
	Work with the sales team to generate qualified leads and increase conversions.
	Market and grow sales of printer toners, printers, computer accessories, and other ICT products.
	Requirements
	Proven experience in content creation and digital marketing.
	Proficiency in Canva, CapCut, and other photo/video editing tools.
	Strong understanding of social media marketing, content strategy, and audience targeting.
	Hands-on experience with keyword research and SEO fundamentals.
	Experience running successful Facebook, Instagram, and other social media advertising campaigns.
	Excellent copywriting and communication skills.
	Sales-driven mindset with a passion for achieving measurable business growth.
	Ability to analyze marketing performance and improve campaign results.


What We're Looking For


	We are not just looking for a only content creator, we're looking for someone who understands how to use content and digital marketing to generate leads, increase sales, and grow a brand.
	If you have a track record of delivering measurable marketing results, we'd love to receive your application.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Content Creator & Digital Marketing Executive Application" as the subject of the email.

Application Instruction
Portfolio Requirement:
Applicants to may be asked to provide verifiable evidence of previous work, including:


	Social media pages they have managed.
	Businesses or brands they have handled.

DevOps & Cloud Engineer Job at Corona Management Systems




        
    

        
        Corona Management Systems is a Social Enterprise that operates with the belief that committed individuals who have a passion for solving problems, can with the right tools change the world. Our mission is to champion the delivery of country-owned high-impact interventions for health including nutrition and food sufficiency, WASH, gender, and economic empowerment) through advocacy, community engagement and technical support for policy development and for the use of data for action in improving governance and service delivery. CMS succeeds by leveraging community assets, institutionalising data use for action, and deploying information and communications technology (ICT).

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



Job Position: DevOps & Cloud Engineer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Engineering Manager

About the Role


	We're looking for a skilled DevOps and Cloud Engineer to help design, build, and maintain the infrastructure that powers our products.
	You'll work at the intersection of development and operations, automating processes, optimizing cloud environments, and ensuring our systems are reliable, secure, and scalable.
	This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and wants to have a direct impact on how we build and ship software.


What You'll Do


	Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure cloud infrastructure (AWS / Azure / GCP).
	Build and improve CI / CD pipelines to streamline deployment processes.
	Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
	Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability; respond to incidents and drive root-cause analysis.
	Implement and maintain containerization and orchestration solutions (Docker, Kubernetes).
	Collaborate with software engineers to optimize application deployment and performance.
	Strengthen security practices across infrastructure, including access controls, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
	Manage configuration and environment consistency across development, staging, and production.
	Contribute to on-call rotation and support incident response.
	Document infrastructure, processes, and runbooks for team-wide visibility.


What We're Looking For
Required:


	3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Engineering roles.
	Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
	Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, etc.).
	Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
	Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or Go).
	Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, etc.).
	Solid understanding of networking, security, and system administration fundamentals.
	Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, etc.).


Nice to Have:


	Relevant cloud certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, etc.).
	Experience with GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Flux).
	Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet).
	Experience working in regulated or high-compliance environments.
	Background in cost optimization and cloud governance.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary and equity package.
	Flexible / remote work options.
	Professional development budget and certification support.
